scope: Conservative production/build dependency closure from bun_runtime over exact pinned manifests + Cargo.lock. All optional and target-specific non-dev deps retained; feature/target reachability not narrowed. Excludes dev-dependencies.
algorithm: Traverse dependencies and build-dependencies, including all target-specific/optional declarations, in exact source Cargo.toml manifests from bun_runtime; resolve names/versions through committed Cargo.lock. Exclude dev-dependencies. Verify each registry .crate SHA256 against Cargo.lock. Preserve complete shipped license/notice/AUTHORS texts; add missing complete upstream license text at .cargo_vcs_info.json exact Git revision and preserved source copyright/SPDX headers.
